headline: This build introduces a unified set of header button icons and fixes backpack title alignment in small mode.

entries.title: Unified header button glyphs
entries.details: All header buttons across bag, bank, and vendor panels now share a sharp, consistent icon style matching the settings gear. Themes can also recolor these glyphs or replace them with custom artwork.

entries.title: Backpack title alignment in small mode
entries.details: Fixed an issue where the backpack title would shift toward the center rather than staying left-aligned when using small mode.
